name: PushOwl
summary: Shopify web-push and omnichannel marketing, now part of Brevo. One-click push lets stores re-engage shoppers who never leave an email, recovering abandoned carts and browsing sessions, then add email, SMS and WhatsApp on Brevo's deliverability stack. Usage-based pricing: you pay for what you send, not list size.
best_for: Shopify stores that want to win back abandoned carts and browsing sessions with one-click web push, reaching shoppers who never handed over an email, and then layer in email and SMS, starting on a free tier that does something
skip_if: you're not on Shopify (it's built exclusively for it), or you need a full standalone email platform: the 500-email bundle cap means heavy senders keep paying extra per credit
honest_knock: The bundles are push-first: every paid tier still caps included email low (1,000 a month on Plus and 1,500 on Power in the app on 17 November 2026, against 500 on the free bundle), so 'omnichannel' email at any real volume means buying separate credits, and consumption-based pricing gets harder to predict as your sends climb. It's also Shopify-exclusive, so it becomes a dead end the day you move platforms.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month ($180/yr) for 10,000 web push messages

plans.name: Basic

plans.name: Plus
plans.includes: 10,000 web push (10,000-30,000 band), 1,000 emails in the app, abandoned-cart automation

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on apps.shopify.com/pushowl and in our own test that day; earlier: prices read 2026-08-17 in a browser and re-read unchanged on 2026-10-04 on pushowl.com/pricing, with both billing toggles) This is priced per channel and then added up, which is the part worth understanding before you compare it with anything. Each bundle sets a separate rate for email, web push and SMS, and the monthly figure is their sum. Basic is $0 and covers 500 emails and 500 web push notifications a month with no SMS credits. Plus is $19/month for 10,000 web push (10,000-30,000 band) and adds abandoned-cart automation. Power is $79/month for 25,000 up to unlimited web push, with flash-sale and browse-abandonment triggers, segmentation and custom attribution windows. Yearly billing is advertised at 10% off, and 20% on the web push side of Plus: billed yearly, Plus shows $15 a month and Power $71, with email at 500 sends on Basic and SMS at zero credits in every bundle as read on 4 October 2026 (on 17 November 2026 the app showed 1,000 emails on Plus and 1,500 on Power). It is Shopify-only. Read again on 17 November 2026: the Shopify listing, now titled Brevo PushOwl: Email, Push, SMS with Brevo PushOwl as the developer, shows the Basic Bundle free (500 web push notifications a month, emails from 500, unlimited subscribers), the Plus Bundle at $19 a month or $180 a year ($15 a month) and the Power Bundle at $79 a month or $852 a year ($71 a month), at 4.8 from 2,322 reviews. The Plus card now gives emails from 1,000 a month. In our own test the same day on a Shopify development store the dashboard pricing page showed the Basic Bundle as the current plan at $0.00 with 0 of 500 web push impressions and 0 of 500 email credits used, Plus at $19.00 with 10,000 push and 1,000 emails, Power at $79.00 with 25,000 push and 1,500 emails, and no SMS credits on any plan, with a Buy credits button. Abandoned cart recovery was marked as available on the Plus bundle and browse abandonment on the Power bundle. Selecting Plus opened Shopify's approval screen: $19.00 every 30 days, with an Add payment method row and no line saying the charge would not be billed, so we did not approve it.
